scope: Bounded Stage-II decoder diagnostic; no new-method, full-reverse-diffusion, uncertainty-validity or quality claim
inputs: Reuse completed case prepared.npz, denoised.npz and sequence.npz after their native report hashes validate. Preserve all 16 forward Stage-I latent rows, frame-0 source mesh, faces, cached FP32 XYZ/normals and query IDs. No input video, image encoder, denoising, Stage0 regeneration, GT or alignment is read for correction.

arms_in_order.name: forward
arms_in_order.required_control: Bitwise equality to the native 16-frame sequence; failure blocks other arms and interpretation.

arms_in_order.name: row_permutation
arms_in_order.clock_times: 15..0, so each physical frame retains its original label
arms_in_order.required_control: Timestamp-preserving permutation must have moving-coordinate RMS/D <=1e-4 and maximum absolute coordinate error/D <=1e-3; failure blocks reversal interpretation.

arms_in_order.name: time_reversal
arms_in_order.required_control: All 16 physical frames once, exact anchor bytes, unchanged faces/query IDs. Disagreement must be interpreted relative to permutation noise, never as GT error.

api: Call frozen ActionMeshAutoencoder.forward with explicit latent, framestep, source_alpha, target_alphas, query and callback, then its existing apply_displacement in native direct mode. Use official get_scaling/apply_scaling. Do not call generate_mesh_animation with anchor_idx=15 or drop_first=True.
numeric_policy: Keep native stacked latent dtype, FP32 checkpoint storage and cached FP32 query; CUDA FP16 autocast exactly as original StageII. Native LatentBank promotes its FP16 Stage0 anchor while stacking FP32 generated rows; verify exact promoted values, do not reject that native dtype promotion. Forward mismatch is an adapter/numerics qualification failure, not scientific direction evidence. Record recomputed feature discrepancy but decode cached features.
signal_rule: Report reversal RMS over the fixed anchor bbox diagonal and the ratio to max(permutation RMS,1e-8). A ratio >10 is an implementation-level separation from the canary floor, not evidence of useful uncertainty or improved quality.
outputs: Fresh separate directory, every arm predeclared, sequence.npz in common physical chronology with all16 identities, source/query/weight/code hashes, alpha mappings, per-arm reports, progress and resource samples. Preserve failures and blocked arms.

resource_budget.qualification: Parent audited native GPU samples between stage1_completed and stage2_completed and authorized a6144MiB reservation for one decoder with three SERIAL arms. This adapter peak remains unmeasured. Parent scheduler enforces aggregate reservation6144+native10752+headroom2048=18944MiB. No backward pass or additional model residence; allocator cap does not bound all driver memory.

later_evaluation: After both control gates pass, use untouched official full16 CD4D/CDM and common anchor alignment; report every case/frame and geometry/motion-amplitude changes. Do not average directions as a new method in this diagnostic.
seed_control_caveat: Existing seed43 native cases may regenerate Stage0 and change topology. Compare external geometry/motion metrics across those runs, never subtract their vertex arrays by index. A same-anchor independent Stage-I-noise contrast would need its own frozen protocol; it is not run here.
interpretation: A nonzero reversal difference shows decoder coordinate-direction sensitivity. Known prior work already covers reversal fusion, reversal consistency and group averaging. Error prediction beyond seed variation and useful intervention remain untested.
validation_this_task: Source/API inspection plus CPU-only mapping/identity fixtures; no SSH, GPU launch, model loading or direction result.
